items.claim: Anthony Hernandez excels at relentless wrestling, consistently taking opponents down and maintaining top control to tire them out.
items.quote: once Hernandez takes you down, he makes your life hell. He's going to take you down and he's going to come, you know, consistently punch and throw and ground and pound over and over and over again and he's again he will tire you out.

items.claim: Gregory Rodrigues has never been submitted in his career.
Gregory Rodrigues will stun and wobble Hernandez at some point in the fight.
items.quote: I think there is going to be a moment in this fight where Gregory Rodrigues is going to stun Hernandez and wobble him.

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez did not deal with adversity particularly well in his fight against Strickland.
items.quote: something that he didn't do particularly well the Strickland fight.
